run.notes: Path S3-P2 with an autocomplete selection (A16) that sent the request at once. Selecting the completion 'plan a trip to gothenburg sweden' sent it at once, so none of the constraints went out. The plan was then rebuilt over several refinement loops: the follow-up chip (A17) 'We are a couple traveling on a mid-range budget', two typed refinements (dates; origin + transport in budget + no museums), the Computer suggestion (A17) 'Build a Stockholm-to-Gothenburg mid-range budget spreadsheet…' (11 min agent run, Excel workbook) and the chip (A17) 'Add a day-by-day itinerary sheet…'. The 2,500 SEK budget and 'no taxi or bus' were never entered in this run.
